The activity was designed to practice an action without performing the real task. A learner treated a folded towel as a heavy parcel. She signed an empty receipt, lifted it with both hands, and placed it on an imaginary loading belt. The instructor paused midway to ask which parts were imaginary and which objects were actually present. Everyone could identify the substitution. They repeated the sequence slowly, then returned the ordinary objects to their normal uses. The scene depended on deliberate pretending, not a mistaken description of the room.
